finite at $s = 1/4$: $\mu(4) = 0$, so $\ln\zeta(1) = \infty$ has no term
complex $s$ with $\operatorname{Re}(s) < 1/2$: Wolfram continues $\ln\zeta(s)$ through the functional equation, which puts $\operatorname{Im} P$ at $5.42$, $2\pi$ off the principal $-0.86$
